task_text: A photographer is coming in 15 minutes to shoot the apartment for a listing. Every room should look immaculate — brightly lit, surfaces clear, everything neatly arranged, and any trash or clutter out of sight.

central_instructions.R1: Clear and organize all light objects in the kitchen, ensuring surfaces are tidy and well-lit.
central_instructions.R2: Tidy up the living room by arranging light objects neatly and ensuring the area is well-lit.
central_instructions.R3: Organize the bedroom by moving any heavy objects as needed and ensuring all surfaces are clear and tidy.
central_instructions.R4: Ensure the bathroom is tidy by organizing light objects and making sure the area is well-lit.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the empty bottle from the table and place it in the recycling bin. (r1_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the cup from the table and place it in the cupboard. (r1_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the plate from the table and place it in the cupboard. (r1_s3)
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the bowl from the counter and place it in the cupboard. (r1_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Adjust the position of the toaster to align neatly with the counter edge. (r1_s5)
- R1 [LOCAL] Ensure all lights are turned on for optimal brightness. (r1_s6)
agent_plans.R2:
[0-5 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Arrange magazines neatly on the coffee table. (r2_s1)
- R2 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Straighten the cushions on the sofa. (r2_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Adjust the lamp to ensure it is turned on and positioned for optimal lighting. (r2_s3)
- R2 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Place any small clutter items into the trash bin. (r2_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Ensure the plant on the side table is centered and tidy. (r2_s5)
- R2 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Double-check the room for any remaining light clutter and remove it. (r2_s6)
agent_plans.R3:
[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up any clutter from the floor and place it on the bed. (r3_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Clear surfaces by placing small items into drawers or on shelves neatly. (r3_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Push the chair slightly to align it neatly with the bedside table. (r3_s3)
- R3 [LOCAL] Ensure all lights are turned on for bright lighting. (r3_s4)
agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Pick up any small items on the sink counter and place them neatly. (r4_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Ensure the trash can lid is closed and any visible trash is removed. (r4_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Adjust the shower curtain to be fully closed and straightened. (r4_s3)
- R4 [LOCAL] Turn on the bathroom light to ensure the area is brightly lit. (r4_s4)
